children: Tianci International announced a hosting agreement with BTC Digital to deploy and operate its recently contracted cryptocurrency mining machines.
Entered hosting, installation, testing, and O&M agreement with BTC Digital to support recently purchased mining equipment.
BTCT to provide facilities, power, network, environmental controls, security, technical support and deployment services in the U.S.
Deployment will proceed upon equipment delivery, acceptance, transportation, installation and testing, with staged operational rollout.
Parties will evaluate additional hosting capacity and deeper technical/operational cooperation based on initial performance data.
Expansion plans and timing depend on market, financing, equipment availability, site/power resources and regulatory conditions.

title: Tianci International inks hosting deal with BTC Digital for mining machines, plans expansion
